chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn 'Imran from Ziyad al-Qandi from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: If there are two Thursdays at the beginning of the month, then fast the first of them, for it is superior. And if there are two Thursdays at its end, then fast the last of them, for it is superior.
ai.seo_question: Which Thursday should be fasted if there are two Thursdays at the start or end of the month?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in *al-Istibsar* offers a practical jurisprudential guideline for the recommended three days of fasting, prioritizing the first or last Thursday of the month based on lunar visibility. It reflects the Shia emphasis on aligning acts of worship with the natural rhythm of the lunar calendar, ensuring the fasting days are distinct and spiritually significant. This ruling underscores the importance of intentionality in selecting voluntary fasts to maximize their spiritual merit.
